steps.name: throughput-sweep
steps.summary: Replaced single-concurrency test_sustained_throughput with a parametrized test_throughput_sweep([5,20,50,100,200]) plus test_throughput_sweep_summary in benchmarks/bench_throughput.py; per-level results write to benchmarks/results/throughput_c{N}.json (no hard threshold assert), summary picks the highest zero-error-rate level as max_sustainable_concurrency/rps and asserts it clears THROUGHPUT_MIN_RPS. README's throughput bullet updated to describe the sweep.

steps.name: overhead-sweep
steps.summary: Extended bench_overhead.py to sweep concurrency [5,20,50,100,200] via PLEXON_BENCHMARK_SWEEP_CONCURRENCIES (mirroring step 0's bench_throughput.py pattern): factored warmup+before/after-metrics-diff logic into _measure_overhead_at_concurrency, renamed test to parametrized test_overhead_sweep writing gateway_overhead_c{N}.json per level with total_requests scaled to max(200, concurrency*10), only hard-asserts OVERHEAD_P95_MS at concurrency=5 (the calibrated level) while other levels report a passed field for visibility; added test_overhead_sweep_summary writing overhead_sweep_summary.json. README's overhead bullet updated to describe the sweep with concurrency=5 as the gate.
